title: $C^{1,1}$ Regularity Global Estimates for Homogeneous Complex Hessian Equations on Punctured Domains
summary: In this paper, we prove the $C^{1,1}$ regularity of Green functions associated with the complex $k$-Hessian operator for $1\leq k<n$, and give a new proof of the corresponding regularity of pluricomplex Green functions. We establish real Hessian estimates for approximating problems associated with homogeneous complex Hessian equations on punctured domains. The main idea is to introduce new auxiliary functions generated by complex linear vector fields to reduce the global real Hessian estimate to the boundary.
